blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— Police arrested a 33-year-old businessman in a drug buy-bust operation in Sarrat, Ilocos Norte, on Thursday. In a report on Friday, the Sarrat Municipal Police Station seized five heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) weighing a total of 1.61 grams.
